title: amazing starlings murmuration (full HD) -www.keepturningleft.co.uk
summary: Footage of a huge flock of starlings performing a murmuration, filmed by wildlife cameraman Dylan Winter. The flock moves in tightly coordinated shapes.
why: Cited as a benchmark for leaderless swarm behavior that robots and drones could aim to match.
